title: pathology-data-mining/mussel-nf pipeline - params.samples_csv schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.samples_csv

slide_id.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

slide_path.errorMessage: Path to slide must be provided and must have extension '.svs', '.tiff', '.tif', '.ndpi', or '.scn'

file_id.description: GDC file UUID; required when needs_download=true so DOWNLOAD_SLIDE can fetch the file.

file_name.description: Original GDC filename (e.g. TCGA-BR-A44T-01Z-00-DX1.<uuid>.svs); used by DOWNLOAD_SLIDE.

needs_download.description: Set to true when slide_path does not yet exist and must be fetched via DOWNLOAD_SLIDE.
